raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the IBF (International Boxing Federation) is recognized by the World Boxing Hall of Fame (WBHF) instead of the International Boxing Hall of Fame (IBHOF). While the WebSurfer correctly identified that Vince Phillips held the IBF junior welterweight title, the Planner made an assumption about the larger Hall of Fame without verifying it. The IBHOF, not WBHF, is the widely recognized Hall of Fame for boxing organizations, including the IBF. This incorrect association led to the wrong final answer.
